citation.title: Effect of volume expansion with hypertonic- and isotonic saline and isotonic glucose on sodium and water transport in the principal cells in the kidney
citation.authors: Jensen JM, Mose FH, Bech JN, Nielsen S, Pedersen EB

protocol.dietary_prep: 4 days standard diet: 120 mmol sodium/day, 2500 ml water/day, overnight fast
protocol.additional_water: 175 ml oral water every 30 min during examination (including prep)
protocol.note: Oral water intake during protocol complicates renal-only boundary validation

infusion.volume_ml: not explicitly stated, estimated from protocol

urinary_sodium_excretion.note: Table 3 units require verification: u-Na listed as mmol/min with baseline 1.24 at FENa 1.26%, plasma Na 138.1 mmol/L, GFR 98.1 ml/min/1.73m2. Expected: (FENa × GFR × plasma_Na) = 0.0126 × 98.1 × 138.1 = 170.7 mmol/min, not 1.24. Possible units: µmol/min or µmol/s.

validation_envelope.scope: isotonic saline IV with concurrent oral water intake
validation_envelope.usable_for: urine flow response qualitative pattern, plasma sodium stability within normal range

notes: Oral water intake (175ml/30min) during protocol means input boundary not purely IV
Urine flow data usable for qualitative response pattern validation
Sodium excretion units unverified - Table 3 values inconsistent with calculated FENa
Published group means suitable for tier 3 face validity checks
Individual traces not available - cannot perform calibration or holdout validation
